_note: HookSwapPerps MATCHING/SETTLEMENT chains — the engine matches + settles perp markets across EVERY chain listed here simultaneously. One entry per chain. A market's chain comes from which registry it lives in (fetchAllMarkets tags each). Adding a chain = a new entry here + the matcher/keeper key env vars it names (NO code change). See EXTENSIBILITY.md > Multi-chain. Keys are NEVER in this file — only the ENV VAR NAME that holds each key (matcherKeyEnv / keeperKeyEnv); the engine/keeper read the key once from that env var and never log it. rpcUrls is an ORDERED list of PUBLIC RPC endpoints with AUTOMATIC FAILOVER (index 0 first; a failing endpoint is cooled down ~60s and the next is used). rpcUrl (single string) is still accepted. rpcUrlEnv / rpcFallbackEnv name env vars that PREPEND to the list and may themselves be COMMA-SEPARATED lists. Anything not listed here is topped up from the built-in validated table in src/rpc/endpoints.ts, which also BLACKLISTS endpoints that answer HTTP 200 with wrong data. NO Alchemy / keyed providers anywhere (Reggie, 2026-08-02). Sepolia used to default to ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com — now BLACKLISTED (403 on eth_getLogs + archive eth_call). gasMode: 'eip1559' (RH + default) sends maxFeePerGas/maxPriorityFeePerGas; 'legacy' sends gasPrice (only for chains that require it — a legacy gasPrice below an EIP-1559 chain's base fee reverts 'max fee per gas less than block base fee', which is why RH MUST be eip1559).

chains._comment: Sepolia (11155111) — canonical HookSwapPerps self-service factory stack (factory v4 0xa1A8C5A2… → impl v5, per contracts/perps/config/factory-sepolia.json). MANDATORY first-validation chain. matcher = the existing engine key (MATCHER_PRIVATE_KEY); keeper = KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY. gasMode eip1559 (Sepolia supports 1559; keeps parity with RH).

Robinhood Chain (4663) — MAINNET PILOT of the self-service factory stack (factory 0xedD55A2E…, per contracts/perps/config/factory-robinhood.json). matcher = the PILOT deployer 0xc14C (its key lives in contracts/.env DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY; set RH_MATCHER_PRIVATE_KEY to that value in the engine env — NEVER hardcode the key). Replace with the real perps-engine matcher before production (each market's setAuthorizedMatcher / factory.setPlatformWiring). gasMode MUST be eip1559 (RH ~0.12 gwei base fee; legacy reverts).
